title: Optimum Nutrition Micronised Creatine Monohydrate Powder, 317g
description: Product Description Optimum Nutrition Micronised Creatine Powder is designed for athletes and active individuals looking to support peak performance during demanding training. Each serving provides 3g of creatine monohydrate to help increase physical performance during successive bursts of short, high-intensity exercise*in a simple and versatile format. Creatine helps support increased training capacity, muscle strength and power, giving your muscles the energy they need when training your hardest. During demanding workouts, it can help you do more reps, sets and sprints. Featuring micronised creatine monohydrate for excellent mixability, this unflavoured powder mixes easily into water, juice or protein shakes with no gritty taste or texture. Enjoy before or after training, or as part of your daily routine to support your performance goals. Backed by Optimum Nutrition’s reputation as the World's #1 sport nutrition brand**, this supplement ensures quality, purity, and results you can trust. *Creatine helps increase physical performance during successive bursts of short, high intensity exercise. **Source: Euromonitor International Limited; Consumer Health 2025 Edition, Sports Nutrition category, % retail value shares, 2024 data. Ingredients EN INGREDIENTS: Creatine Monohydrate. May Contain: Milk, Gluten, Egg, Soy, Nuts and Peanuts. Directions Creatine Powder is micronized for easy mixing. Simply add one rounded scoop (3.4 g) to 240 ml (8 oz) of cold water, your favourite beverage or ON shake, and mix until powder is dissolved. Recommended daily consumption of 1 serving per day. Safety Warning Not for use by those with pre-existing medical conditions or those taking any medications, those under the age of 18 or women that are pregnant or breast-feeding. Food supplements are not to be used to substitute for a varied diet. Do not exceed recommended daily dose. Keep out of reach of children. Use in the framework of a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Legal Disclaimer Dietary supplements are not a substitute for a balanced and diversified diet. Box Contains Micronised Creatine Monohydrate powder, 1x serving scoop Manufacturer Contact Information 4 Waterside, Dublin 24, Ireland See more
